description: Name: Kibbutz Gevim - water pipeline to the NegevDescription: A detailed plan for laying two water lines from a borehole in the Nir Am area to the settlements in the Negev was the work of Mekorot engineer - Simcha Balas, who initiated the bringing of 200 km long pipes, which were offered for sale in London.
